primitives.name: Automatic Speech Recognition Transcription Layer
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Verdict:** ADAPT — multilingual ASR-derived commentary layer over 550 SoccerNet games (1030 halves with commentary) with transcription-quality evaluation, hallucination-mitigation heuristic, and verb-noun NLP analysis; directly adaptable to NFL broadcast-audio mining for injury/lineup/tactical intelligence.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'WER': 'Word Error Rate (dimensionless)', 'CER': 'Character Error Rate (dimensionless)', 'BLEU': 'Bilingual Evaluation Understudy score (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: First-30-s language detection generalizes to full half; vocabulary diversity anti-correlates with hallucination; batch translation adequate for downstream English tasks.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Speechless/noisy audio leads to hallucinations; entity recognition errors on player/team names.

layer2.mapping: Maps raw broadcast audio to structured temporal segments with linguistic content for downstream NLP and tactical inference.

primitives.verbatim_quote: Model selection: per-video best-model distribution (v3 46.9%, v1 30.7%, v2 22.4%).
primitives.assumptions: Higher unique-word ratio correlates with lower hallucination rate; model selection based on heuristic rather than ground truth.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Low unique-word ratio indicates high repetition and potential hallucination.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a confidence-weighted voting system across ASR models for optimal transcription fidelity.

primitives.verbatim_quote: NLP analysis: dependency parsing for verb-noun pair extraction, sunburst visualizations of action-dynamics vocabulary.

It operates under the assumption that automatic language detection from initial audio is representative of the entire half. The model selection heuristic 'model_selection_heuristic' chooses the best Whisper version per video based on unique-word ratio, mitigating hallucinations. This selection process is grounded in empirical observation that higher lexical diversity correlates with reduced repetition and thus fewer hallucinations. The derived kernel 'verb_noun_action_extraction' applies dependency parsing to extract semantic action pairs from these transcriptions, enabling tactical reasoning.
